messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: The Crestor brand of rosuvastatin tablets is distributed by AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals LP, Wilmington, DE 19850, under license from Shionogi & Co., LTD., Osaka, Japan.
Generic versions are also manufactured by several other companies.
Ezallor Sprinkle (rosuvastatin) has been discontinued and is no longer available.
Triplet: ["Ezallor Sprinkle", "is discontinued", "Rosuvastatin"]

The relation 'is discontinued' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug product is no longer available for sale or use, specifically for the drug specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
B. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
C. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
D. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
E. 'has not been studied in': The subject drug has not been evaluated or tested in the patient population or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
